artifacts.purpose: Binary cli invocation and exit only
Arguments, stdout document and exit handling

interfaces: Application API accepts explicit paths/options and returns typed result/error, independent of CLI.
CLI emits exactly one versioned JSON document for every operational success/failure; diagnostics avoid sensitive values.
App supplies UUIDv7/UTC RFC3339 timestamp; check performs evidence/policy/alignment validation without metrics/publication.
acceptance_criteria: check performs no scoring or writes; evaluate publishes exact snapshots and returns result_path to report.json and exact result_sha256.
Unknown arguments/settings fail; help/version work; poor performance/no_data exit 0.
Process tests run Cargo binary in temporary directories and exercise exits 0/2/3 plus error mapping unit tests for 4.

verification.expected: Single JSON stdout, expected exits, stderr separation and filesystem effects.
Help/version exempt; malformed arguments structured and safe.
Independent SHA-256 of actual report equals receipt.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
